rights.disposition: all visible text licenses are inside the vendored Axolotl subtree; BRIEF-Pro/src/license.svg is a website asset and no root license covers BRIEF/BRIEF-Pro code or data

environment_findings.evidence: current HEAD postdates BRIEF v2 and combines BRIEF, BRIEF-Pro, a project website, and a vendored training framework; it is not an author-declared immutable historical BRIEF experiment revision
492 of 601 files are a vendored Axolotl subtree, so repository-level source/test counts do not describe paper-specific implementation maturity
BRIEF requirements pin Torch 2.1.2+cu121, FlashAttention 2.5.9.post1, Transformers 4.29.2, Datasets 2.19.0, and other Python packages but do not pin external model/data revisions or a base image
the BRIEF-Pro LongBench conda environment ends with an absolute machine-local prefix under /data2/junyizhang
separate Axolotl, vLLM, and LongBench environments use different Torch, Transformers, CUDA-linked, and serving packages without one top-level lock

artifact_findings.evidence: the 49-file BRIEF subtree contains training/inference utilities, pinned Python requirements, six response datasets, six ground-truth files, and two synthetic multi-hop test sets
the root README links a Hugging Face model and dataset and provides train/evaluation entry points, but immutable Hub revisions and a full derivation/checksum manifest are absent from this audit
the README instructs users to download LongBench files and run a conversion script; current tree includes LongSeal but not a self-contained immutable evaluation bundle
BRIEF-Pro/eval includes a CPython 3.10 __pycache__ file, indicating the paper-specific tree is not a source-only release
BRIEF/code/Utilities/apikey.json exists; its contents were deliberately not inspected or exposed and any reproduction must use a secret-free fixture

reproduction_boundaries: resolve root rights for paper-specific source, scripts, prompts, model links, and data independently of vendored Axolotl
identify an author-confirmed immutable revision for BRIEF v2 and BRIEF-Pro v2 separately
pin Hugging Face model/dataset revisions and all LongBench/source-data derivations
remove credentials and generated bytecode from any clean-room fixture
build separate network-denied training, compression, reader, and evaluation environments
validate reported source coverage and compression targets from per-example manifests
measure compressor plus reader time, FLOPs, memory, energy, and failures on named hardware
do not use released outputs as held-out novelty evidence without contamination and split audits

decision.next_action: seek author-confirmed paper-specific revisions and rights; retain BRIEF/BRIEF-Pro as conceptual baselines without executing or reusing the combined tree
